name: IO 性能诊断 — IO 性能问题的综合诊断方法
description: 数据库 I/O 性能综合诊断规则。覆盖 I/O 延迟分析（db file sequential/scattered read）、存储吞吐量评估、ASM I/O 统计、文件级和表空间级 I/O 热点定位。I/O 是数据库最常见的性能瓶颈之一。

signals.key: db file sequential read / db file scattered read

root_causes.name: 存储延迟高
root_causes.desc: 底层存储（SAN/NAS/本地盘）延迟高。SSD 应 < 1ms，SAS 应 < 5ms，SATA 应 < 10ms。

root_causes.name: I/O 热点（单文件瓶颈）
root_causes.desc: 特定数据文件承受过多 I/O 请求，其他文件空闲。通常是热点表/索引集中在同一文件。

root_causes.name: SQL 导致过多物理读
root_causes.desc: 低效 SQL 未走索引导致全表扫描，大量物理读。Buffer Cache 命中率低。

root_causes.name: 多路径（Multipath）或 ASM rebalance
root_causes.desc: 多路径切换或 ASM rebalance 正在进行导致临时 I/O 延迟升高。

root_causes.name: I/O 调度器或 OS 参数不优
root_causes.desc: Linux I/O 调度器未设为 deadline/noop（SSD 应用 noop），或 hugepages 未配置导致 swap I/O。

step1_io_wait_events.desc: 检查 I/O 相关等待事件
step1_io_wait_events.sql: SELECT event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000,2) avg_ms, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE event IN ('db file sequential read','db file scattered read','db file parallel read','direct path read','direct path write','log file sync','log file parallel write') ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC

step2_file_io_stats.desc: 按文件检查 I/O 统计
step2_file_io_stats.sql: SELECT f.file#, f.name, s.phyrds, s.phywrts, ROUND(s.readtim/GREATEST(s.phyrds,1)*10,2) avg_read_ms, ROUND(s.writetim/GREATEST(s.phywrts,1)*10,2) avg_write_ms FROM v$filestat s JOIN v$datafile f ON s.file# = f.file# ORDER BY s.readtim DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

step3_tablespace_io.sql: SELECT ts.name, SUM(s.phyrds) reads, SUM(s.phywrts) writes, ROUND(SUM(s.readtim)/GREATEST(SUM(s.phyrds),1)*10,2) avg_read_ms FROM v$filestat s JOIN v$datafile f ON s.file# = f.file# JOIN v$tablespace ts ON f.ts# = ts.ts# GROUP BY ts.name ORDER BY SUM(s.readtim) DESC

step4_ash_io_sql.desc: 从 ASH 找 I/O 密集 SQL
step4_ash_io_sql.sql: SELECT sql_id, COUNT(*) io_samples, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) sessions FROM v$active_session_history WHERE event IN ('db file sequential read','db file scattered read') AND sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE GROUP BY sql_id ORDER BY io_samples DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step5_asm_io.desc: 检查 ASM 磁盘 I/O 统计
step5_asm_io.sql: SELECT dg.name dg_name, d.name disk_name, d.path, d.reads, d.writes, d.read_errs, d.write_errs, ROUND(d.read_time/GREATEST(d.reads,1)*1000,2) avg_read_ms FROM v$asm_disk d JOIN v$asm_diskgroup dg ON d.group_number = dg.group_number WHERE d.reads > 0 ORDER BY d.read_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

step6_os_io_check.sql:
-- iostat -xm 5 3
-- 关注: await, svctm, %util
-- 推荐: await < 5ms, %util < 80%
SELECT 'Run iostat on OS for disk-level metrics' AS action FROM dual
